description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a Button Hotplug driver, handling button events and generating uevents.

classes.name: bh_priv
classes.description: Private data structure for button handle context, including seen state and input handle.

classes.name: bh_event
classes.description: Represents a button event, including name, action, seen timestamp, skb buffer, and work struct.

classes.name: bh_map
classes.description: Mapping between button/key codes and their string names.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a variable string to the event's skb buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event with standard environment variables for uevent.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Work handler that constructs and broadcasts the uevent.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a new button event.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map array.

methods.name: button_hotplug_event
methods.description: Handles input events, triggers button event creation.

methods.name: button_hotplug_connect
methods.description: Handles connection of input device, registers handle.

methods.name: button_hotplug_disconnect
methods.description: Handles disconnection of input device, unregisters handle.
